E2A_E2B_DIVERGENCE_REPORT.why: f4c1105 section 4 requires that 'The non-execution, AND THE E2A/E2B DIVERGENCE THAT CAUSED IT, is reported in place of any policy comparison.' befca0d section 2.3 adds that the divergence 'blocks adoption of any E4 conclusion until explained.' This block discharges that obligation inside the sealed gate document.

e2a_sealed_attribution.plurality: B (retention) is the strict plurality of {A, B, C+D}

E2A_E2B_DIVERGENCE_REPORT.the_divergence: E2a (fresh worlds) makes RETENTION the dominant non-success mechanism: B=196 is the strict plurality, which is why Gate 2 locked to EXECUTE_E4A. E2b (Held-out replay) makes CROSS-SEED the dominant mechanism: LOST_IN_CROSS_SEED=71 is 49.3 percent and outranks LOST_IN_RETENTION=55. The two surfaces therefore disagree about WHICH stage the remediation should target.
E2A_E2B_DIVERGENCE_REPORT.why_it_is_not_a_measurement_disagreement: E2b reproduces v1's retained-level measurement exactly: v1 oracle_any_seed_correct vs E2b (SUCCESS or LOST_IN_CROSS_SEED) agrees 144/144 (75/69), and per-case v1 seeds_with_g2_success == E2b seeds_with_retained_correct on 144/144. The divergence is in ATTRIBUTION -- which pipeline stage is blamed -- not in what was observed. 124 of 144 cases are relabelled.
E2A_E2B_DIVERGENCE_REPORT.consequence_per_frozen_authority: befca0d section 2.3: 'If E2a and E2b disagree ... the fresh worlds do not reproduce the Held-out regime, which invalidates E2a as a calibration surface.' This places E2a's status in question, not merely E4a's. It is recorded here as a protocol-owner matter; E2b may not adjudicate it, being DECISION_INADMISSIBLE.

CAP_DEPENDENCE_DISCLOSURE.why: Disclosed at CRITIC_A's request so the record is not stronger than the evidence.
CAP_DEPENDENCE_DISCLOSURE.note: For those 12 cases neither evaluator completed an uncapped run, and both evaluators share the same 5s cap and the same invariance enumeration, so for them the 144/144 dual-evaluator agreement is weaker evidence than for the other 132. The bound is still sound -- it over-approximates the achievable outcomes, so it can only ever refuse to decide, never decide wrongly -- and per-case unresolved_rows are exposed in the DETAIL column of FROZEN_DIRECT_CLASSES.csv. Hard bound on the consequence: NEVER_ON_FRONT=14 rests on cases with unresolved_rows=0, so the 43-case generation deviation that carries the FAIL is essentially cap-free.

CASE_LEVEL_RECONCILIATION_WITH_V1.why: Without this the FAIL reads as a replication failure or a corpus problem. It is neither.
CASE_LEVEL_RECONCILIATION_WITH_V1.per_case_integer_agreement: v1 seeds_with_g2_success == E2b seeds_with_retained_correct on 144/144 cases
CASE_LEVEL_RECONCILIATION_WITH_V1.interpretation: E2b agrees with v1 PERFECTLY on everything v1 was able to observe -- the retained-candidate level -- and diverges ONLY where E2b added information v1 never had: the front. The failure is of ATTRIBUTION, not of measurement or replication.
